title: Velvety Winey Argentinian Almond Butter Hash
description: A rich and indulgent breakfast dish from Argentina, combining the creaminess of almond butter with the warmth of wine and the crunch of vegetables, all in one cast-iron skillet.

ingredients.name: red wine
ingredients.notes: use a full-bodied wine like Malbec or Cabernet Sauvignon

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large cast-iron skillet over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until it's softened and lightly browned, about 8 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the sliced red bell pepper and cook, stirring occasionally, until it's tender, about 4 minutes.
Add the sliced zucchini and cook, stirring occasionally, until it's tender, about 4 minutes.
Add the diced tomato and cook, stirring occasionally, until it's heated through, about 2 minutes.
Stir in the almond butter and red wine, and cook, stirring constantly, until the mixture is smooth and heated through, about 2 minutes.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
If desired, garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve hot.
Let the hash rest for a few minutes before serving, to allow the flavors to meld together.
